fields.label: Key
fields.description: A short name in lower case, for example kavya. It is the guide's address and its id.

fields.label: Area
fields.description: Which of the site's guides does the work: pandit_ji (astrology, Rudraksha, gemstones and poojas), numerologist, dream_guide or tarot (tarot readings). The rules, tools and knowledge are the area's; this guide only speaks differently. Filled from the skills when left blank.

fields.label: One line
fields.description: Shown under the name, for example Love and compatibility, in Hinglish.

fields.label: About
fields.description: Two or three lines on how this guide talks and what it helps with. It is an AI guide; say so, and claim no years of experience or credentials.

fields.label: Suits
fields.description: Who it suits, separated by commas, for example Gen Z, Students.

fields.label: Languages
fields.description: For example Hinglish, English.

fields.label: Leans toward
fields.description: What it is best at, separated by commas, for example Love, Marriage.

fields.label: How it speaks
fields.description: A few lines the guide is given: its tone, its language, how long its replies are. Not needed when the profile below is filled. The area's own rules, boundaries and tools still apply and cannot be changed here.

fields.label: First line
fields.description: What the guide says when a chat opens, after Hi and the person's name.

fields.label: Picture
fields.description: A portrait, 3:4, head and shoulders. Until one is attached a lettered picture is shown.

fields.label: The picture is AI-made
fields.description: Tick when the picture is made by an AI tool and the person it shows does not exist. It is then labelled on the guide's page.

fields.label: Profile id
fields.description: The id of the profile this guide was made from (for example ASTRO-NUM-001). Importing the same profile again never makes a second guide.

fields.label: Skills
fields.description: Up to three. A guide uses the knowledge and tools of its skills, within its area's own. All of them must be on for the guide to be shown.

fields.label: Traits
fields.description: Separated by commas.

fields.label: Signature line
fields.description: Used now and then, not in every reply.

fields.label: Way of working
fields.description: One step per line, in order.

fields.label: Shape of an answer
fields.description: One part per line.

fields.label: Boundaries
fields.description: One per line. Added to the area's own, never replacing them.

fields.label: Picture brief
fields.description: What the portrait should show, for whoever makes the picture.

fields.label: Price of a Minute
fields.description: What one minute of talk with this guide costs when the person buys AI minutes in the chat (their plan's free minutes cost nothing). Minutes bought are used with any AI guide.
